summary: A nonzero indefinite two-hub core plus robust original-product slope innovation does not absorb an arbitrary completed same-bank remainder. For independent cap-one X,Y,C uniform on [-1/2,1/2], Q=X^2-epsilon Y^2+2CY-C^2/epsilon=X^2-epsilon(Y-C/epsilon)^2 has an unbounded logarithmic density for every 0<epsilon<=1, while its slope innovation is exactly one. The 3x3 matrix has spectrum {1,-(epsilon+epsilon^-1),0}, so this is not a QFORM counterexample; it proves the genuine third curvature must be retained on the indefinite near-null branch.
